definitions.explanation: To grasp the meaning of something. Used for understanding language, concepts, feelings, or situations.
To be able to identify or distinguish something. {違|ちが}いが{分|わ}かる (to know the difference).

definitions.gloss: to be found out, to become clear
definitions.explanation: For something to be discovered or determined. {結果|けっか}が{分|わ}かる (the results become known).

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{分|わ}かりますか。
examples.notes: Note: が not を with {分|わ}かる

examples.japanese: {意味|いみ}が{分|わ}かりません。

notes: {分|わ}かる takes が (not を) for what is understood: {日本語|にほんご}が{分|わ}かる (understand Japanese). This is because {分|わ}かる expresses a state rather than an action - the thing understood is the subject of understanding, not the object. Also written as {解|わ}かる or {判|わ}かる with slightly different nuances. Te-form: {分|わ}かって.
